sources.title: Sulphur 2 Base - Dev | LTX Video Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: Sulphur 2 Base is an uncensored, community-built video generation model on top of LTX 2.3. It runs text-to-video and image-to-video natively and supports every other LTX 2.3 format, with an optional prompt enhancer and distill LoRA in the same release.
